svg.desc: Follow the numbered connectors. The server checks the question and recent context. When fresh database data is needed, first read the cached schema, fetching it from PostgreSQL if missing; next ask the AI provider to generate SQL using that schema; then validate and execute the SQL against PostgreSQL. Only after rows return does the server optionally ask the AI provider to explain them. Without an explanation, return the SQL and table directly. Questions that need no fresh data can receive a direct answer or clarification. Progress updates, schema browsing, cancellation, and local result exploration support this journey.
